prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption, adoption visual/photo improvements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact grid, style stage redesign, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, session reset safeguard hints, background readiness hints, initial post-adoption sign-in relocation, and wait progress checklists/carousels consistently won.
Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners/flows, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, and interactive sound/visual wait progress hurt performance.
No clear effect seen: Background/audio notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, subsequent sign-in reorderings, waiting overlay hints and time indicators, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, pre-upload style inspections, custom pet style selectors, split-view path screens, session safeguard hints, background hints, and wait progress checklists/carousels performed better than predicted.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, initial post-adoption sign-in relocation, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Compact Companion Welcome Dashboard Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a compact dashboard showcasing active desktop controls and pet status. (why: The finish step has a low conversion rate of 64.8% and long mean completion time (5815s), with users reporting confusion about controlling desktop pets.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Preset Companion Selection Studio View: Add a new studio selection screen before pick_friend to let users visually browse preset companion visual archetypes. (why: Adoption has a mean duration of 1017s; visual adoption studio elements consistently win in previous tests.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Waiting Auth Stage Reorder: Reorder the onboarding flow so sign-in takes place right after waiting, immediately before the finish desktop view. (why: Moving authentication later protects early adoption momentum while securing session persistence before desktop launch.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Setup Checklist Stage: Display an active setup checklist on the waiting screen showing desktop environment preparation steps. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean 2336s; progress checklists consistently perform well during long waits.)
4: [home, notification] Background Processing Desktop Alert Prompt: Add an optional readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when generation finishes. (why: Reduces waiting drop-off and mitigates long generation times (mean 2336s) by allowing users to switch tasks.)
5: [choose_path, incentive] Instant Companion Activation Highlight: Add a visual badge highlighting fast-track instant adoption options on the path selection screen. (why: choose_path conversion is 83.5% with a long tail mean time (514s); explicit path highlights accelerate selection.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Action Headline Copy: Update headline and body text on home intro screen to explicitly describe basic desktop pet controls. (why: Support mail showed confusion on how to control or hide pets, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
